title: Brand-new player cannot claim the Daily gift: Claim says 'Nothing was claimed' and the card stays the same
steps: Empty storage, phone 390x844, open /game/ (lands on the Home screen)
Tap 'Daily gift' in the footer
Card: 'Today's gift: 36 shards. Days claimed: 0'. Tap Claim
expected: The gift is claimed (or the button is hidden / says 'Visit the Town first to open your mailbox' before it is tapped)
actual: Text appears: 'The gift will wait until your town save is ready. Nothing was claimed.' The Claim button is still there and still does nothing. A new player has no idea what a 'town save' is or how to make one. Also reproduced after playing a Stack Tower round (still no town save). The gift is in 'shards', a Realm currency the player has not met yet.
suspect: game/hub/gift.js:63-66 (pay() fails with no pixeltown-save-v1; claim rolled back)

title: First call to action contradicts itself and the plan: PLAY says 'Start in the Town', the Next line says 'Make a first friend (Isles)', the guided Adventure (Realm) is a third card
steps: Empty storage, phone, /game/
Read the top of the Home screen
expected: One call to action (SIMPLIFY-PLAN section 6: Play leads into the guided Realm shore; Isles is revealed in session 2)
actual: Big PLAY goes to the Town join card (a form with name + 10 hero portraits + live-server join), the line right under it points to the Isles, and the Realm tutorial (the only real coached first session) is a small card in the grid. Three different 'first moves'.
suspect: game/hub/home.js:117 (default Play target = town), game/hub/calm.js (first 'Next' = Isles friend)

title: Town join card has no Menu (compass), and its only way out is a pill labelled 'Back to the map' that actually goes to the Home screen
steps: Empty storage, phone, /game/ then tap PLAY
Look for the Menu / 'Where to?' button
Tap '← Back to the map'
expected: The compass Menu top-left like every other page; a back pill that says 'Back to Home' (the hub-lane rule: a Hub referrer reads 'Back to Home')
actual: No #mm-nav-btn on the join card. Pill text 'Back to the map' but it lands on /game/hub/index.html in the Home view (not the map). The card also offers '↩️ Continue: Home', a third wording for the same place.

title: New player died on the tutorial shore within 45 s while following coach card 3 ('Walk over a loot bag'); a world event timer ('Raid in 0:08', 'Swarm in 0:06') runs from the first second
steps: Empty storage, phone, Home > The Realm, tap Thicket Ranger
Do coach 1 (left stick) and 2 (right stick), both advance fine
Card 3 'Walk over a loot bag to pick it up': walk around looking for one (no bag or arrow is shown)
expected: The first minute on 'Shore · Safe-ish' is safe, a bag is visibly dropped or pointed at, no event countdown during the coach cards
actual: At 44 s HP 0/100: 'You fell in the Realm… no 💎 lost'. The coach card 'Walk over a loot bag 3/6' stays on top of the fall panel. The top banner showed 'Raid in 0:08 · Midlands' at spawn and 'Swarm in 0:06' at death. The fall text wraps into a tall narrow box with no visible 'Try again' button.
suspect: games/mad-maze/realm-tutorial.js (no bag guarantee/pointer for step 'bag'), realm-world event timer

title: Map view: the default node 'Pixeltown Square' opens a card that only says 'Not visited yet / Coming soon' (dead end on 'Open')
steps: Phone, Home screen, tap 'Map' in the footer
Tap 'Open'
expected: Open plays/enters the place you stand on, or the player starts on a real place
actual: Card 'PIXELTOWN SQUARE, Pixeltown Crossroads, Not visited yet' with a disabled 'Coming soon' button. The map also uses different names from the Home cards: 'Hearthvale' (Town), 'The Lantern' (Lantern Camp), 'Lakeside Angler', 'Hearthvale Isles'; the HUD names the player 'VILLAGER'.

title: Town breaks the shared layout: Menu is a 'Where to?' button top-right (compass top-left everywhere else), 13 counters in the HUD, A/C buttons 50 px, emote bar across mid-screen, 'Hold to talk' in an offline town
steps: Phone, Home > PLAY, type a name, Join (DB blocked) > PLAY OFFLINE
expected: CONTROLS.md: Menu top-left, Primary/Secondary >= 56 px bottom right; SIMPLIFY 5: at most 3 numbers on the HUD
actual: '🧭 Where to?' at 260,62 top-right; inventory HUD shows 13 numbers; #interact-btn 'A ✋' and #mobile-chat-btn 'C 💬' are 50x50; quick emote bar (Hi!/lol/Fishing!/Nice!/Bye!) sits at y=562 over the play field; walkie 'Hold to talk' shown while offline. Different art style (cream panels, sans font) from the 8-bit Home.

title: Stack Tower end card has 'Play again' and 'Replay seed' but no 'Menu'/'Home' button (SIMPLIFY 3: Again + Menu)
steps: Home > Stack Tower > Play, drop until it falls
expected: End card: score, best, Again, Menu
actual: Only PLAY AGAIN, REPLAY SEED, Share code COPY; the way home is the small compass top-left. The end card also prints 'Keys: Space, Enter or Down drops' on a phone.

area: Text walls / key names on touch
title: Phone players are shown keyboard keys and long how-to text before Play (Isles, Pixel Pop, Stack, Realm skip link, Town join card, Settings Help)
steps: Phone, open Isles, Pixel Pop, Stack Tower, Town join card from Home
expected: SIMPLIFY 3: no key names on a coarse pointer; at most 25 words before the first Play
actual: Isles 'How to play' 5-item list incl. 'WASD / arrows', 'Space or click'; Pixel Pop intro ~60 words + 'Keys: arrows move, Enter or Space pops'; Stack ~60 words; Town join card footer 'WASD/arrows to walk · E · B · 1-9 · P · Enter to chat'; Realm DOM skip link 'WASD move, Space fire, Esc menu'; Settings > Help lists keyboard keys only.

title: Lantern Camp is still a separate destination with its own second hero creator; Arcade shows all 9 games on first run; 'World map' is listed under ADVENTURE in the Menu
steps: Phone, empty storage, Home > Lantern Camp
Open Menu 'Where to?'
expected: SIMPLIFY 2: Lantern Camp is a screen of the Adventure; Arcade starts with 3 games; World map is a Home thing
actual: Lantern page has its own 'NEW HERO' form (class dropdown + name field) and 'Account fame' while the Realm uses a portrait picker; a hero made in the Realm does show up here (good). Home grid shows 13 places at once. Menu: World map card sits in ADVENTURE.

title: Home footer duplicates and confuses: '← Town' (= PLAY), 'Open' (opens a map card over Home), 'Map'; desktop hides Collections below the fold
steps: Phone or desktop, Home screen, read the footer; desktop 1280x720: look for Collections
expected: Footer with Map, Daily gift (or the gift in the mailbox), nothing that duplicates PLAY
actual: Four buttons, two of which (Town, Open) a new player cannot explain. On 1280x720 the Collections row and part of Quick games are under the footer (scroll needed). Known P4 for 'Open' in bugbash/hub.md; confirmed.

title: With the server unreachable, the player waits ~13 s from the root URL before 'Play offline' appears, and Join is disabled with no hint until a name is typed
steps: Phone, DB blocked, /game/ > PLAY
Look at JOIN TOWN before typing (disabled, no reason shown)
Type a name, Join
expected: A short wait, or Play offline offered at once beside Join; disabled Join says 'Type a name first'
actual: 'Can't reach the town server... play offline' after ~10 s of waiting on Join (13.4 s from the root URL). Disabled Join has no reason text.

title: Realm phone HUD has two menu buttons (compass top-left and ☰ top-right) plus Leave, Daily and a settings gear between the thumbs
steps: Phone, Home > The Realm, pick a hero
expected: One Menu top-left; nothing between the thumb sticks (CONTROLS: nothing sits over the thumbs)
actual: 🧭 (where to), ☰ (Realm menu), 'Leave', 'Daily' above the left stick and #mm-gear-btn at 173,790 between the two sticks.
